2893-3470-4826-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

575-1794-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.
575-1794-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-2921-5131-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

738-4659-7707-7883.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nontoken creature.
738-4659-7707-7883.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Super-Adaptoid, adding {C}{C}.
When Super-Adaptoid dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a nontoken creature they control.
When a creature dies this way, Glissa triggers, returning Super-Adaptoid from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Super-Adaptoid by paying {2}.
When Super-Adaptoid enters, it triggers, choosing Glissa and giving Super-Adaptoid deathtouch and first strike.
Repeat as able.
738-4659-7707-7883.notes: You can repeat this lock during each of your turns so long as an opponent controls a nontoken creature.

3946-5155-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

38-2523-2869.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Skirk Prospector that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Skirk Prospector token

4276-5088-5231-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
4276-5088-5231-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
4276-5088-5231-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

757-3094-7014.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

413-891-2843.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
647-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Urabrask the Hidden so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

240-1115-2034-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2097-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1438-4481.easyPrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1438-4481.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1438-4481.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

579-2366-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1879-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

129-4289-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-4289-5137.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

2866-3967-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3661-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-4336-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3140-5541-6085.notablePrerequisites: Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
3140-5541-6085.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

349-1811-2825.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
349-1811-2825.description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Cerulean Wisps without paying its mana cost, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying Cerulean Wisps for each creature you control, with each copy targeting a different creature.
Resolve a Cerulean Wisps copy, untapping the creature it is targeting and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining Cerulean Wisps copy.
Repeat from step 1.

1375-3247-3258-5091.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
You control no Snakes.
1375-3247-3258-5091.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Venser's Journal and Ophiomancer trigger.
Resolve the Venser's Journal trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Resolve the Ophiomancer trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing the Snake token, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

614-1987-2510-5116.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
614-1987-2510-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

738-1778-1969-4050.description:
Sacrifice Memnite to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Memnite to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
